adapted_from.source_text:
Using the uploaded reference image of [BEVERAGE PRODUCT], create a dynamic commercial beverage photograph.

Place the product upright in the center of the frame with a controlled splash of [LIQUID] moving around the base and sides. Add a limited number of relevant ingredients, such as [INGREDIENT 1] and [INGREDIENT 2], suspended naturally in the scene.

Use high-speed studio photography with crisp frozen motion, strong backlighting through the liquid, a soft frontal fill light, realistic condensation, and fine droplets on the packaging.

Use a background based on [BRAND COLOR], with enough contrast to separate the product clearly.

Preserve the exact can or bottle shape, cap, label, logo, typography, color, and packaging proportions. The label must remain readable and undistorted. Do not add fictional flavors, claims, or product text.

High-speed beverage advertising, photorealistic liquid physics, sharp focus, 4:5 aspect ratio.
